# make option() respect normal variables set before add_subdirectory().
# yyjson declares an old cmake_minimum_required, so without this policy its
# option() calls would ignore and override the values set below.
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)

set(YYJSON_BUILD_TESTS ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_BUILD_TESTS})
set(YYJSON_BUILD_FUZZER ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_BUILD_FUZZER})
set(YYJSON_BUILD_MISC ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_BUILD_MISC})
set(YYJSON_BUILD_DOC ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_BUILD_DOC})
set(YYJSON_ENABLE_COVERAGE ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_ENABLE_COVERAGE})
set(YYJSON_ENABLE_VALGRIND ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_ENABLE_VALGRIND})
set(YYJSON_ENABLE_FASTMATH ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_ENABLE_FASTMATH})
set(YYJSON_FORCE_32_BIT ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_FORCE_32_BIT})
set(YYJSON_INSTALL ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_INSTALL})
set(YYJSON_SANITIZER "${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_SANITIZER}" CACHE STRING
    "Sanitizer for tests: address, undefined, memory" FORCE)

set(YYJSON_DISABLE_READER ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_READER})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_WRITER ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_WRITER})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_INCR_READER ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_INCR_READER})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_FILE ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_FILE})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_UTILS ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_UTILS})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_FAST_FP_CONV ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_FAST_FP_CONV})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_NON_STANDARD ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_NON_STANDARD})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_UTF8_VALIDATION ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_UTF8_VALIDATION})
set(YYJSON_DISABLE_UNALIGNED_MEMORY_ACCESS ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_DISABLE_UNALIGNED_MEMORY_ACCESS})
set(YYJSON_FREESTANDING ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_FREESTANDING})
set(YYJSON_READER_DEPTH_LIMIT ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_READER_DEPTH_LIMIT})
set(YYJSON_WRITER_DEPTH_LIMIT ${SLXIO_EXTERN_YYJSON_WRITER_DEPTH_LIMIT})

add_subdirectory(src)
